answer: Proposal: an audited issuer enforces one anonymous credential per person; each epoch's claim carries nullifier H(secret,epochID), so the ledger rejects duplicates and slashes the bond. Cloned keys share one credential, like shoots on one trellis: one root, one slot. An orchard of sybil keys cannot spiral weight upward, since weight binds to credentials, not addresses. Buying real identities costs linearly and stays revocable; it fails while bribe plus revocation risk exceeds the capped per-epoch reward. Issuer deduplication is the admitted trust.
